attempt: That the printed value needs a rule the list omits: the joint effect of AFTER and BEFORE on one phrase (intersection), the boundaries fixed before replacement starts, the treatment of ITEM as a character-string (GR3a), the left-to-right order (GR2), or ALL distributing over BY phrases (GR14); or that a named id is wrong or missing.
reason: From the named rules alone: QUOTE is the one character " (IV GR5, length 1 by SR3); first " at position 3 opens eligibility at 4 (GR8c), first # at 12 closes it before 12 (GR8b; both say "only", so their ranges intersect, and both fix the position before the first cycle). p7 gives every ALL phrase AFTER QUOTE BEFORE "#"; GR18 pairs A>X B>Y C>Z D>X; GR7a-d scans and GR15b replaces positions 4..11 AEBDFBCD to XEYXFYZX: AC"XEYXFYZX#AB"D, as printed. GR14 is not needed because each phrase writes ALL. GR2 and GR3a add nothing GR7 does not already say for a character item. Ids 7, 8, 15, 18, SR3 and IV GR5 are in the catalog; p7 is a GR row (85e-01 OVERTURNED it to GR) that this import mints.
quoted: it refers to an implicit one character data item
